collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — DEPARTURES AND EXILE (DEP-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Leaving and being left: moving huts, short journeys, visitors going home, goodbyes done well and badly, homesickness, and the rare person who sails away for good. Choosing to leave is never a rejection of one's people, and choosing to stay is never a failure.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

collection.description: A visiting healer who taught a villager about plants leaves tomorrow: ask one last question, or just say thank you.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: For a whole moon a healer from another village has been teaching (name1) about plants: which ones calm a cough, which ones soothe a burn, which ones you must never put anywhere near your mouth. Tomorrow the healer goes home. (name1) has a hundred questions left and one evening to ask them.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (name1) picks the one question that has been bothering (him/her) most: "What do you do when nothing works?" The healer is quiet for a while. Then they talk, honestly, until the fire burns down. It isn't an answer exactly. (name1) remembers all of it anyway.

o2__fx.name: Outcome B
o2__fx.text: (name1) puts the questions away and simply thanks the healer. They talk about ordinary things: food, weather, the healer's grumpy old dog back home. In the morning the healer leaves a bundle of dried leaves outside (name1)'s door, with a note: "For the questions you didn't ask. Work them out. You'll be fine at it."

text_only.reason: food in the story (a meal, a catch, fruit); the village's stores do not change -- the draft's notes: everything but the marked effects is story only
